name: Multiplayer
author: Keros
description: Online co-op: a Multiplayer item in the title's main menu, under Load Game, whose pages (the game's own menus) list the games others host, create one from a save or a new game, join one by its code, or play without a server with Direct connect. The host's Start starts the game for everyone: all play in the host's level, see each other's Ratchets, and share its world (its enemies go for the nearest player, a hit on one counts for all, crates and kills are shared, bolts go to whoever collects them). Includes co-op rescue, host rally points and a team-tools page in the existing Multiplayer menu, whose pages speak the game's five PAL languages. In Going Commando, a first co-op without the menu: the party is chosen in the settings (host, join by code, or direct), and everyone plays in the host's level and sees each other.

settings.name: Server
settings.description: The OpenRAC server to connect to, as host:port (7770 when no port is given).

settings.name: Name
settings.description: Your name in multiplayer: 3 to 16 letters, digits or underscores. Defaults to the launcher's Multiplayer name.

settings.name: Party
settings.description: Going Commando has no Multiplayer menu yet: what to do when the game starts. Host a party on the server (its code shows over the game), join one by its Code, host directly without a server (port 7770 open), or join a direct host's Address. Once in a level, the host's game is the party's.

settings.name: Code
settings.description: The code of the party to join (Join by code): the six letters and digits the host's game shows.

settings.name: Address
settings.description: The direct host to join (Join an address), as host:port (7770 when no port is given).

settings.name: Revive fallen players
settings.description: When you host: a player who falls stays down for a while, and another player standing over them brings them back.

settings.name: Hold the party
settings.description: When you host: your ship waits for the others. Each presses Start when ready, or goes after 30 seconds; your Start on the new planet takes them at once.

settings.name: Verbose log
settings.description: For reports: an [mp-trace] line for each event of the party's world (pauses and the cameras under them, mobys left out of the game's updates by distance, hidden, shown or removed with who removed them and why, snapshots, drives, kills and spawns, a census each second), in mp-trace.log beside the game's run.log. Also on with OPENRAC_MP_TRACE=1.
